OMPL 2.0.2, released 2026-08-14, BSD 3-clause.
Upstream: https://github.com/ompl/ompl/releases/tag/2.0.2
Source archive: https://codeload.github.com/ompl/ompl/tar.gz/refs/tags/2.0.2
SHA256: D867190A46A7F730923475A68AF2E09FC9E796017A59BE395A4BF3900D0C3AE4
Unmodified upstream core sources, matching the directory set in upstream
src/ompl/CMakeLists.txt. Demos, Python and optional extensions are excluded.
Boost 1.87.0 and Eigen 3.4.0 are shared with the pinned Coal dependencies.
Boost.Serialization sources are linked statically. Debug uses the Debug CRT
and STL ABI with optimized algorithms, matching the host process.
OMPL does not implement CAD collision or machining policies. The neutral
IConfigurationPathPlanningService accepts numerical axes and caller-supplied
state and entire-motion validators. The current evaluation uses RRTConnect,
an initial direct-path check and bounded path simplification. Timeouts and
invalid endpoints are reported explicitly; approximate goals are rejected.
This evaluation module is not enabled in the production product manifest.
